title: Preview post — blog layout fixture
excerpt: A placeholder article used to review the blog index card and the article template. It contains no real content and should be deleted before launch.
body:
This post is a **layout fixture**. It carries no information about Paelon, its
services, or its clinicians — it exists so the blog index and article templates
can be reviewed before real editorial content is written.

## What this fixture exercises

Every element below is here to be looked at, not read. If one of them renders
badly, the template needs work.

- An unordered list, of the kind a health article would use for symptoms or steps
- A second item, long enough to wrap onto a second line on a narrow phone screen so line height and hanging indent can be judged properly
- A third, short item

### A third-level heading

Paragraph text under a subheading, with *emphasis*, **strong emphasis**, and an
[internal link](/contact) so link colour and underline offset can be checked
against the surrounding copy.

CLAUDE.md requires at least two contextual internal links in every post body,
and a link to a route that does not exist is a build failure — so a second one
points at the [branch directory](/locations). Both targets are routes that
actually resolve today; when the fixture is replaced, the real article's links
must do the same.

> A pull quote. Long-form health writing leans on these, so the template needs
> one that holds its own against the body text without shouting.

## An ordered list

1. First step
2. Second step, which is deliberately longer so that the marker alignment can be checked when the text wraps
3. Third step

## Closing section

A final paragraph, so the spacing between the last block and the author card
below is visible. Delete this post once real articles exist.
